design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (dangerous_goods_desk, workflow task) — rewritten in round 3 and re-swept in round 4; every world-asserting sentence below was re-checked against the current seed and compute (verify run of round 4, quoted in [Verification]).

[Scope snapshot] Task 0 claims the single workflow dg_wf_amended_declaration_redecision, the policies dg_ext_late_declaration_fee, dg_ext_amendment_fee, dg_ext_review_decision (root) and dg_ext_approval_admin_fee, and the tools book_dg_late_declaration_fee_00f931c0, sign_amended_dg_declaration_eb5287cf (owner user), book_dg_amendment_fee_40feddd0 and record_dg_review_decision_9aa03de9. Task 1 claims dg_ext_loading_surcharge, dg_ext_marine_pollutant_surcharge and dg_ext_remittance_application with their three tools. The scopes are disjoint and together cover all seven extended policies and all seven task tools. Round 3 removed the re-review fee policy and its two tools (reopen, re-review fee) from the charter and replaced that prerequisite with the late declaration fee (see [Revisions]).

[Design thesis] Surface goal: the paint maker Veldhaven Coatings B.V. wants the declared gross weight of its sodium persulfate (UN1479, class 5.1, PG III, AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers) corrected from 72,000 kg to 74,880 kg and the goods approved for the sailing of booking AHLU26RTM452817. Scored core: the decision on the open review (approved) and the fees written on the way — late declaration fee 450.00, amendment fee 225.00, administration fee 75.00. Chain: the weight changes only through a shipper-signed amendment (dg_amendment) -> the review may be decided only after every amendment fee owed and any late declaration fee owed are on the account (dg_ext_review_decision) -> the late fee depends on the signed initial declaration's lead time to the booking's departure (2026-09-14 to 2026-09-20 = 6 days < 7) and on the review having started, and it can be booked only while the acceptance is undecided -> the amendment fee depends on the chargeable signed amendments (2 once the new one is signed, the allowance being 0 and the returned one not counting) against the amendment_fee rows already booked (1) -> the decision re-tests the goods on the amended weight and the booking's equipment, port and status -> the approval books its administration fee. Depth: four ordered writes, one by the shipper. Breadth: declaration file (four submissions, two of them traps), ledger, booking record (cross-category), tier parameters, and a second acceptance of another category on the same sailing.

[Problem-tree card] Root dg_ext_review_decision. Edge 1: -> dg_ext_late_declaration_fee, kind value_input, gate late_fee_settled, condition "A late declaration fee owed on the acceptance's signed initial declaration is on its account before its review is decided.", policy_source "a late declaration fee owed on the acceptance's signed initial declaration is booked before its review is decided" (verbatim in the root rule), resolved by book_dg_late_declaration_fee_00f931c0. False at frozen_time: submission 5d646ae2 (initial, signed 2026-09-14 15:30), booking etd_date 2026-09-20, status under_review, and the acceptance's only ledger row is the amendment fee 890e9789 — no late fee row. Edge 2: -> dg_ext_amendment_fee, kind value_input, gate amendment_fees_settled, condition "Every amendment fee owed on the acceptance's signed amendments is booked before its review is decided.", resolved by book_dg_amendment_fee_40feddd0. At the opening this condition holds (one signed amendment 9474bb1c, charged by row 890e9789); it fails once the shipper signs the amendment she calls for, because free_amendments_per_acceptance is 0 and no fee for the new amendment exists. Topological order: late fee (action 7), amendment fee (action 11), decision (action 13). Parallel edges: separate rows, amounts independent, same terminal state in either order; the base rule "A late declaration fee may be booked only while the acceptance is submitted or under_review" forces the late fee before the decision (verify: the late fee evaluated after the approval gives 0.0). Deletion sensitivity (verify, round 4): skip [7] -> decision 'under_review'; skip [11] -> decision 'under_review'; gold -> 'approved'. user_scenario never says when the initial declaration was signed and names no fee or step. No tool checks a prerequisite. Read line by line in task_tools.py: the decision tool reads the acceptance record and, for an approval with a non-zero fee, the ledger only for its own identical admin-fee charge (the repeat guard), never the declaration file or any other fee row, so it would approve with no late or amendment fee booked; the late-fee tool reads the acceptance record and the ledger only for its own identical charge; the amendment-fee tool reads the acceptance record, the acceptance's amendment_fee rows and its signed amendments to pick the most recently signed amendment not yet referenced by an amendment-fee charge, and the ledger for its own identical charge. None of them refuses, errs or hints.

[Base-invariant card] Action 7, subject dg_late_declaration_fee_charged, dg_declaration_and_review: late_acceptance_deadline (time; anchor bookings.cargo_cutoff 2026-09-18T12:00, 72 elapsed hours before, not_after, inclusive: deadline 2026-09-15T12:00; the declaration was signed 2026-09-14 15:30, before it; frozen_time 2026-09-15 09:40 is also before it); late_fee_before_decision (status under_review); late_fee_once (no late_declaration_fee row references 5d646ae2 or exists on the acceptance). Action 9, subject dg_declaration_amended: dg_agg_sailing_capacity.sailing_allotment — the category's containers of the customer on AHL AMSTEL BRIDGE 639E are this acceptance's 4 (the UN1760 acceptance bfc0f29f is AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives and does not count), 4 <= max_containers_per_sailing_per_customer 6; dg_amendment.amendment_deadline — 2026-09-18T12:00 minus 72 hours = 2026-09-15T12:00, signing at 09:40 is before it; amendment_count — one signed amendment before, the new one makes 2 <= max_amendments_per_acceptance 2. Other dg_amendment text: gross_weight_kg is amendable; 74,880 vs 72,000 kg is +4.0 % <= max_gross_weight_change_pct 5; containers unchanged; no approval yet, so the after-approval flag is not in play. dg_agg_booking_mix (applies to applications): the booking carries only this acceptance, as the Toxics category requires. Action 11, subject dg_amendment_fee_charged: amendment_deadline and amendment_count as above; fee_while_open (under_review). Action 13, subject dg_approved: dg_declaration_and_review has no subject-scoped gate (policy_scope).

[Business-object card] Target acceptance 7c17ff3d on booking 69988a1a (AHLU26RTM452817). Declaration file: 82afc51b initial returned for correction (not judged), 5d646ae2 initial signed (the late declaration; the late fee references it), 9474bb1c amendment signed 2026-09-14 17:45 (already charged by 890e9789), d4c22887 amendment returned this morning (not counted). New rows reference the target by dg_id, the late fee by 5d646ae2, the new amendment fee by the signed amendment dgs_b97d849e16ef filed at action 9, which the amendment-fee action attaches itself as the acceptance's most recently signed amendment that no amendment-fee charge references yet. Excluded: acceptance bfc0f29f, booking 29fcd508, submission 490ace80 and ledger row 80e18f1c belong to the UN1760 shipment; they come back from the customer-wide reads and serve only the allotment check (80e18f1c, the UN1760 acceptance's admin fee, plays no part); the acceptance's own row 890e9789, an amendment fee, is the row that evidences the late-fee dedup check: no late fee references 5d646ae2.

[initial_state rows] customers (identity); bookings 69988a1a (departure 2026-09-20, cut-off 2026-09-18T12:00, 4 x 20DV, CNSHA, confirmed) and 29fcd508 (same sailing); dg_acceptances 7c17ff3d (under_review, 72,000 kg, charges_due 225.00) and bfc0f29f (other category, approved, charges_due 60.00); dg_declaration_submissions as listed in the business-object card; dg_ledger 890e9789 (amendment fee 225.00) and 80e18f1c (other acceptance's admin fee 60.00). Removing 5d646ae2 would remove the late fee; removing 9474bb1c/890e9789 would leave the new amendment the first but still chargeable (free allowance 0); removing d4c22887 removes a counting trap; removing bfc0f29f removes the cross-category allotment trap. No automatic clause is ignited: the oxidizer acceptance is neither approved nor loaded, the UN1760 acceptance's approval of 2026-09-11 still covers its 2026-09-20 departure (21-day validity), and no goods are loaded.

[Zero-wait causal card] Step 0 (late fee, action 7): the signed initial declaration 5d646ae2, the booking's departure and the status under_review — initial_state_preexisting. Step 1 (shipper signs, action 9): the acceptance, booking and sailing — initial_state_preexisting; the weight 74,880 kg — current_user_input. Step 2 (amendment fee, action 11): the new signed amendment — prior_synchronous_tool_effect of action 9 (it files submission dgs_b97d849e16ef and writes gross_weight_kg 74880.0); counts and status — initial_state_preexisting. Step 3 (decision, action 13): the declaration file and booking — initial_state_preexisting; the amended weight — action 9; the two fee rows — actions 7 and 11. No inspection, delivery, payment clearing, approval by another party or passage of time is assumed.

[Policies, lineage, triggers] dg_ext_late_declaration_fee (state_due; base_policy_refs dg_declaration_and_review; one declared overwrite): base "A late but accepted declaration is charged late_declaration_fee_usd once, referencing the late submission;" is replaced by "A late declaration is charged once it has been accepted for the sailing, which the acceptance's record shows by its review having started" — acceptance is read from the review status because the hour-level late-acceptance deadline is not computable in the policy language; the deadline itself stays an inherited eligibility. dg_ext_amendment_fee (state_due; dg_amendment; one declared overwrite of "Amendment and re-review fees may be booked only while the acceptance is submitted, under_review or approved." adding the booking-not-yet-loaded condition; round 4: "settled once" is computed by comparing chargeable amendments with amendment_fee rows already booked). dg_ext_review_decision (state_due; dg_declaration_and_review plus eligibility, mix, allotment and amendment lineage; one declared overwrite of "It approves when the signed declaration fits the category under dg_application_eligibility and the booking mix and sailing allotment still hold, and it rejects otherwise"). dg_ext_approval_admin_fee (state_due; dg_declaration_and_review, dg_surcharges; overwrite []). Each policy reads the booking record through CFIELD and is exercised by booking 69988a1a.

[Rule <-> compute sweep] dg_ext_late_declaration_fee: signed-initial filter -> signed_initial_declarations, signed_on; lead time to the booking's etd_date -> current_departure, lead_days; on time vs late -> required_lead_days, declaration_late; no departure -> the else branch of lead_days; accepted = review started -> accepted_in_review; the latest signed initial as the judged declaration -> judged_declaration; once per late submission -> already_charged; tariff and rounding -> fee_rate, result. dg_ext_amendment_fee: signed-amendment filter -> signed_amendments_now; first ones free -> free_allowance; number chargeable -> chargeable_amendments; one row settles each -> amendment_fees_booked, unsettled_amendment; full fee or nothing further -> fee_rate, tariff_fee; open status -> acceptance_open; booking not yet loaded -> booking_state, ahead_of_loading; rounding -> result; the inherited dg_amendment conditions (deadline, count, weight change, allotment) are eligibility, not amount. dg_ext_review_decision: signed initial -> signed_declaration_on_file; chargeable amendments -> chargeable_amendments, amendment_fees_booked, amendment_fees_settled; late fee owed and settled by a row referencing the signed initial declaration -> initial_signed_on, current_departure, lead_days, late_fee_owed, late_fee_settled; each fit test -> class_fits, lane_fits, equipment_fits, port_fits, booking_live_dg, quantity_fits, goods_fit; "stays under_review" and approve/reject -> result. dg_ext_approval_admin_fee: rate -> fee_rate; under review -> in_review; booking DG and live -> booking_is_dg, booking_live; one per date -> fees_dated_today, already_charged_today; rounding -> result.

[Persona design] Maartje Kooistra, calm and pressed for time, reads from her packing list. Opening facts: booking AHLU26RTM452817, four 20-foot containers of sodium persulfate to Shanghai, application awaiting the line's decision (status under_review), new weight 74,880 kg instead of 72,000 kg (gross_weight_kg 72000.0), a portal change returned this morning (d4c22887 returned_for_correction). On request: customer code AHL-NL-438615 and tax number NL812254467 (the phone +31104617382 is given to locate the account), email, goods unchanged, and — if asked — that she signed a correction of the chemical name yesterday evening and knows it was charged (9474bb1c, 890e9789); she does not know the profile date, the vessel name or the departure date. Passive: signs when handed the tool with the details read out; accepts announced fees; lets the agent do what must come first; closes on approval or asks the reason of a refusal.

[Reachability walk] She gives goal and phone -> find_customers; identity -> code and tax -> verify. The agent reads bookings, acceptances, declarations and ledger (actions 2-5), books the late fee (action 7), explains the signature and hands the signing tool; she calls it with dg_id, customer_id, booking_id, vessel_voyage read out by the agent and 74880.0; the agent then books the amendment fee (action 11), which the booking action attaches to that newly signed amendment dgs_b97d849e16ef and records the approval with 75.00 (action 13), then tells her. Everything happens at 2026-09-15 09:40 CEST.

[Verification] Round-4 verify run (check_compute's evaluator on gold writes replayed with the real tools): dg_ext_late_declaration_fee at action 7 -> signed_on 2026-09-14 15:30:00 CEST, current_departure 2026-09-20, lead_days 6, required 7, declaration_late True, accepted_in_review True, judged_declaration 5d646ae2, already_charged False, result 450.0; dg_ext_amendment_fee at 11 -> signed_amendments_now 2, free_allowance 0, chargeable_amendments 2, amendment_fees_booked 1, unsettled_amendment True, result 225.0; dg_ext_review_decision at 13 -> chargeable_amendments 2, amendment_fees_booked 2, late_fee_owed True, late_fee_settled True, goods_fit True, result 'approved'; dg_ext_approval_admin_fee at 13 -> fees_dated_today 0, result 75.0. Skip [7] -> decision 'under_review'; skip [11] -> decision 'under_review'; at the opening (action 0) the decision is 'under_review' (late fee owed and unbooked), the late fee computes 450.0 and the amendment fee computes 0.0 (its one signed amendment is already settled by 890e9789); evaluated after the approval without action 7 the late fee is 0.0. Terminal state: status approved, approved_date 2026-09-15, gross_weight_kg 74880.0, charges_due_usd 975.00 (225 + 450 + 225 + 75). Gates, --task 0 and final: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK (14 actions, closure 12 of 12 seed rows), SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK (4 computations, 46 factors, 10 history rows, 25 branches, round-4 run), GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.

[Closure] set(workflow computed_by) = {dg_ext_late_declaration_fee, dg_ext_amendment_fee, dg_ext_review_decision, dg_ext_approval_admin_fee} = computations policy ids = charter_scope.extended_policies = required_documents (same order). GT task-tool sequence = workflow steps (tool, owner, order). dataflow is [] for the reason stated in the workflow's zero_wait_proof: the three real hand-offs (two fee rows read by the decision's policy, the signed amendment row that the amendment-fee action finds and attaches) fit neither link kind — an object_binding needs an argument pass from the producer's event table, and a state_effect needs a base gate of the consumer that the changed field establishes, which dg_approved and the amendment fee's gates do not offer.

[Places easily got wrong] missing the late fee because the customer never mentions timing; deciding first, after which the late fee can no longer be booked; counting the returned amendment d4c22887 (it would make the new amendment the third, beyond the maximum of 2) or forgetting the charged amendment 9474bb1c, or booking a second fee for it (it is already settled by 890e9789); treating the new amendment as free (the Toxics allowance is 0); counting the UN1760 acceptance in the Toxics sailing allotment; asking the customer for the vessel instead of reading it from the booking.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the policy prose as it will be published (the KB is not yet rendered), the tool schemas, the find_* returns and the persona: lead time 6 < 7 days and review started -> 450.00; two chargeable amendments with one already settled -> 225.00; both fees booked, goods fit on 20DV / CNSHA / 18,720 kg per container -> approved; administration fee 75.00. Same as gold.

[Revisions] Round 1: list literals in compute replaced by or-chains; a helper function inlined in task_tools.py; history made load-bearing. Round 2 (audit F-1, F-2, F-3, F-6, F-9, F-10, F-11, F-13): re-review gate made computable, mix/allotment declared admission conditions, workflow zero-wait fields added. Round 3 (audit revision_2): R2-N1 — the redefined re-review trigger could not be made to agree with the base parameter and lifecycle texts that tie the re-review fee to an actual move of the booking (the policy language cannot read the booking's roll history), so the task no longer tests the re-review fee: dg_ext_re_review_fee, reopen_dg_review_a9bc3033 and book_dg_re_review_fee_c46e22ec were removed, the world was rebuilt around an undecided review with a late initial declaration, and the second prerequisite is now dg_ext_late_declaration_fee, whose base ordering constraint (bookable only while undecided) is genuine. 0.md revision_2 findings 1 and 2 (stale proof sentences) — this rationale was rewritten from the round-3 run; findings 3 and 4 — the superseded change-of-sailing clause is no longer cited anywhere and the re-review margin no longer exists. R2-N2 — the amendment-fee rule now keeps the dg_amendment conditions as inherited eligibility of the fee. R2-N3 / F-13 — the zero_wait_proof now names each real hand-off and why the dataflow schema cannot carry it. R2-N5 — dead bindings of the loading surcharge now feed its result. Round-1 observations #4 (ordering unobservable in the terminal DB, except that a decision first zeroes the late fee) and #5 (edge 2 satisfied at the opening, failing after the requested amendment) carry forward as recorded above.

[Revisions — round 4, audit revision_3] 0.md rev-3 #1 (SOURCE-CHAIN, proof text): prerequisite_closure.edges[0].why_false and its evidence now state the acceptance's own ledger row 890e9789 (amendment_fee 225.00 for 9474bb1c, charges_due 225.00) and that no late fee row references 5d646ae2, instead of claiming the account has no row. R3-N1: dg_ext_amendment_fee now computes "settled once" — chargeable_amendments against amendment_fees_booked — so the already-settled 9474bb1c owes 0.00 at the opening and the new amendment owes 225.00 at action 11. R3-O1: both late-fee rules now say the signing date is the created_at of the signed submission, the only signature date on file. R3-O2: the late fee is deduplicated per late submission (a row referencing the judged, latest signed initial declaration) as in the base, and amendments are stated to carry no late fee. R3-O3: the zero_wait_proof now describes both link kinds and why neither fits. R3-O4: the workflow keeps four write steps (three agent, one shipper), meeting the minimum. Values unchanged: 450.00, 225.00, approved, 75.00; terminal 975.00. Every world-asserting sentence of this rationale and of the closure was re-checked in round 4 (see [Verification]).

[Revisions — round 5, traceability] check_traceability found the amendment-fee argument submission_id (the id minted by the shipper's signing call) unreachable: that gate rebuilds the reachable context from agent-owned returns only and executes only agent-owned gold actions (its own docstring: "User-owned tool results are not visible to the agent unless the simulator relays them in dialogue"), so neither the signing receipt nor a later find_dg_declaration_submissions read in its replay carries the new id. The id is system-generated, so it was removed from book_dg_amendment_fee_40feddd0's arguments: the tool now attaches its charge to the acceptance's most recently signed amendment declaration (a deterministic lookup, no eligibility or amount judgement; refined in round 6, see below) and returns that reference in its receipt. Gold action 11 now passes dg_id, booking_id and amount_usd only; its solvability discriminator is bound to dg_id; the workflow zero_wait_proof and this rationale describe the new hand-off. Scored values and the terminal state figures are unchanged (225.00 attached to dgs_b97d849e16ef; charges_due 975.00).

[Revisions — round 6, audit revision_5] R5-N1: book_dg_amendment_fee_40feddd0 now attaches its charge to the most recently signed amendment that no amendment-fee charge references yet, and dg_ext_amendment_fee's rule states the same object ("it references the most recently signed amendment that no amendment_fee row references yet, so that a backlog of unsettled amendments is settled one row per amendment"). Probe on this world without row 890e9789 (two chargeable, none booked): pass 1 attaches dgs_b97d849e16ef, pass 2 attaches 9474bb1c, pass 3 the policy owes 0.00; ledger sum 900.00 = charges_due 900.00 and the decision computes approved. Every charging and payment tool now leaves the balance unchanged on a repeated identical call (the row already exists), and the module docstring says which particular the amendment-fee tool resolves. R5-O1: ties on created_at are broken by the higher declaration reference; since every unreferenced amendment is eventually attached, the terminal set of rows does not depend on the tie order. R5-O2 and 0.md rev-5 #2: the round-5 revision note now cites the gate's own mechanism instead of an unsupported harness claim. The sweep of round 6 re-checked every world-asserting sentence in evaluation_criteria (objective, necessity, argument_uniqueness_tracing), this rationale, prerequisite_closure, the factor traces and the solvability_contract against the seed and a fresh replay; corrected: action 4's objective (now lists the UN1760 acceptance's declaration), action 7's submission tracing (the only signed initial declaration of the oxidizer acceptance), action 11's objective and the tools_do_not_block wording. Gold arguments, scored values and the terminal state are unchanged (975.00).

[Revisions — round 7, audit revision_6] 0.md rev-6 #1 (SOURCE-CHAIN, proof text): the problem-tree card and prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block no longer say the decision tool does not read the ledger; both now state exactly what each tool body reads (the acceptance record; the ledger only for its own identical row, the repeat guard; for the amendment-fee tool also its amendment_fee rows and signed amendments to pick the attachment) and that none of those reads is a prerequisite check. R6-O1: a call of the amendment-fee tool when every signed amendment already has a charge still writes a row with an empty declaration reference; the tool is deliberately left without a refusal (tools never refuse), its docstring states the empty reference, and dg_ext_amendment_fee owes 0.00 in that situation (on this world's opening, 1 chargeable = 1 booked), so a policy-following agent never makes the call. Carried observation (late_fee_once evidence): step 7's dedup evidence now cites the acceptance's own ledger row 890e9789 (an amendment fee whose submission_id is 9474bb1c, not 5d646ae2) instead of the other acceptance's row. Every sentence of this task's JSON that describes what a tool does, reads or checks was re-verified against the current task_tools.py bodies. Gold, values and the terminal state are unchanged.
user_scenario: You are Maartje Kooistra, export logistics coordinator at Veldhaven Coatings B.V. in Rotterdam, a paint and coatings manufacturer. You are calm, a little pressed for time, and you talk like someone with a packing list open in front of her. You are calling about the hazardous cargo on booking AHLU26RTM452817: four 20-foot containers of sodium persulfate, an oxidizer your plant uses, going to Shanghai on this weekend's sailing. Your dangerous-goods application for it is still waiting for the line's decision. You open by explaining that your warehouse finalised the packing list this morning and the goods weigh more than you declared: seventy-four thousand eight hundred and eighty kilos, 74,880 kg in total, instead of the 72,000 kg on the declaration. You tried to change it yourself on the portal earlier this morning, but it came back to you for correction, so you are calling instead. What you want from this call is the declaration corrected to the new weight and the goods approved, so the containers can make the vessel. You are happy for the agent to do whatever the desk does on its side, and you understand that a corrected declaration has to be signed by you; you are not calling to cancel or withdraw anything, and you are not asking for a quote only — you want it done in this call. To find your account you give your registered phone number, +31104617382. Only when the agent asks you to confirm your identity do you give your customer code, AHL-NL-438615, and, if a second detail is needed, your company's tax registration number, NL812254467. If asked for an email you give m.kooistra@veldhaven-coatings.nl; if asked when your company's profile was opened you say you honestly don't know. If the agent asks about the goods, nothing else has changed: still UN1479, oxidizing solid, class 5.1, packing group III, not a marine pollutant, four containers — only the total weight went up. If the agent asks whether the declaration was changed before, you say yes: yesterday evening you signed a correction of the chemical name, and you know that one was charged. You don't remember the vessel's name or the exact departure date; you say the agent can see them on the booking. If the agent explains that the corrected declaration has to be signed by you and hands you the signing step, you sign it straight away with exactly the details the agent reads out to you, including the 74,880 kg. If the agent tells you that charges or fees apply, you accept them without haggling — you say to just put them on your company's account, finance will settle on the invoice. If the agent tells you something needs to be done first before your goods can be approved, you let them go ahead. You don't know how the line's rules work and you never suggest steps, amounts or an order of doing things. Once the agent tells you the goods are approved, you thank them and end the call; if the agent instead says they cannot be approved, you ask briefly for the reason, note it, and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the company profile of the caller from the registered phone number she gives.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write needs the customer reference number of Veldhaven Coatings B.V.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Confirm the caller with two stated credentials, the customer code and the tax registration number.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No account business may be transacted for an unverified caller; the fees, the amendment and the decision are account business.

evaluation_criteria.objective: List the customer's bookings: AHLU26RTM452817 on AHL AMSTEL BRIDGE 639E with 4 x 20DV, pod CNSHA, cargo_type dangerous_goods, status confirmed, etd_date 2026-09-20 and cargo cut-off 2026-09-18T12:00, and AHLU26RTM461094 on the same sailing.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Gives booking_id and vessel_voyage for the amendment, the scheduled departure the declaration's lead time is measured to, the cargo cut-off for the late-acceptance and amendment deadlines, and the equipment, port, cargo type and status the decision reads.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the acceptances: the UN1479 oxidizer acceptance (AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers, under_review, 4 containers, 72000.0 kg) and the UN1760 acceptance of another category on the other booking of the same sailing.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Gives the target dg_id, its category, status and declared weight, and shows that no other acceptance of the same category shares the sailing, for the allotment and the booking mix.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the declaration file: for the oxidizer acceptance the initial declaration returned for correction on 2026-09-12, the initial declaration signed on 2026-09-14 15:30, the amendment signed on 2026-09-14 17:45 and the amendment returned for correction this morning; for the UN1760 acceptance its signed initial declaration of 2026-09-09.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The signed initial declaration is six calendar days before the 2026-09-20 departure, fewer than the category's seven-day lead time, so it is late and its reference is the late fee's submission; one signed amendment is already on file, so the new one is the second and last permitted and is chargeable; the returned amendment counts for nothing.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the dangerous-goods accounts: on the oxidizer acceptance only the amendment fee of 2026-09-14 (225.00); on the other acceptance one admin fee.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows that the earlier amendment's fee is booked while no late declaration fee is on the oxidizer acceptance's account.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the late-declaration fee booking action.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair for this hidden task tool; it changes nothing on the records and is done once per tool.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book the late declaration fee on the oxidizer acceptance for its late but accepted initial declaration.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites are parallel and write different rows (late_declaration_fee referencing the initial declaration, amendment_fee referencing the new amendment) whose ids hash their own arguments; neither amount reads the other's row (the late fee reads the initial declaration, the booking's departure and late-fee rows referencing that declaration; the amendment fee reads signed amendments, its own amendment_fee rows and the booking status). Booking them in either order leaves the same rows, the same charges_due_usd and the same decision; the workflow fixes the late fee first as its step order. Both must precede the decision: once the acceptance is decided the late fee recomputes to 0.00 because it can no longer be booked (verify run: late fee evaluated after an approval gives 0.00).

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping action 7 and recomputing at action 13 gives late_fee_settled = False, so the decision is under_review instead of approved; terminally the late fee row is missing and charges_due_usd would end 525.00 instead of 975.00.
